title: Lys warns 'One more thing like that and I'm done following you. I only say a thing once' after I killed a wolf that 'would let you pass if you let it be'; I never repeated that exact kind of unnecessary-violence choice again, so it's unclear whether the threshold was real or just flavor -- the game never surfaces how close a companion is to actually leaving.
